memoryBuilder.verseText: I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never be hungry.

sequence.prompt: What happened on the hillside? Put it in order.

items.label: A huge crowd followed Jesus over the hills
A boy gave Jesus five loaves and two fish
Jesus thanked His Father and broke the bread
Twelve full baskets of leftovers were gathered

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: Not nearly enough, until Jesus took them
With Jesus there is always more than enough
Only Jesus can truly fill them

application.question: Jesus never runs out. What do you need from Him today?
application.followUp: Bread fills you until teatime, and then you are hungry all over again. Jesus gives us Himself, and He never runs out — there were twelve whole baskets left over. Jesus is the bread.
